text_block_list.text:
Some time after accomplishing the MC 
rotation――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Now, feast your eyes! Behold 
the gates of hell being shattered!!
choice_data_list: Aah!? The fence is broken to piece...

text_block_list.text: (Snap... roll...)
choice_data_list: Huh?! The fence is broken apart ag...

text_block_list.text:
The fence she kicked through hadn't 
shattered to pieces; the top half was 
still hanging on.
choice_data_list: Wait, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh. Of course you would notice. That 
I have been afflicted by the Naga's
deadly 
venom."
choice_data_list: Could it be you're still tired fro...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I deny it. My body has not forsaken me. 
However, it is also true that a change is 
occurring within me...--
choice_data_list: Are you still tired from the MC ro...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: No... Wait, an MC rotation?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I achieved my dream—and stagnated. If 
that is so... Ah! A new thirst! Together 
with you, I shall gaze beyond the 
Yasuda-Takarazuka rotation—and see it 
through!"
choice_data_list: Beyond that... do you mean finding...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! That's right!
I am the possible 
future... lying beyond the battlefield 
where I stepped down.
choice_data_list: Beyond that... does that mean find...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"A writer? A painter sounds nice too. An 
actor wouldn't be bad either! Now, let's 
choose! A dream worthy of me!"

A few days later. I headed to the dining 
bar to see how her quest for a dream was 
coming along.
choice_data_list: How's it going? Found a new dream yet?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, let me offer a drink for that answer 
first. Think of it as me, served with a 
detective twist.
choice_data_list: Well? Did you find a new dream?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"My brilliant partner found the evidence. 
...Right on the back of the
melody-weaving 
box. Heh heh... Told you this much,
so you get it now, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The one who committed the crime using 
piano wire was... you, the piano tuner!"
choice_data_list: Oh, you're looking the part...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
But I have learned what it means for 
the moon to wane. What a detective enjoys 
is fulfillment—
the intoxication of having 
provided a resolution.
choice_data_list: Whoa, you actually look the part...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"However,
I do not wish to be intoxicated. 
—Rather, I wish to intoxicate others, you 
see."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, for the first glass... a Kir, 
served as a mocktail. Its meaning 
is—"Intoxication."

It was a refreshing mocktail, not overly 
dry. The sweetness of the cassis really 
came through...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then,
here is your next drink. Savor 
it. This is the flavor of my DIY craft... 
of a shopkeeper guiding scrap wood to its 
reincarnation.”

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh, this skull is so cute! Maybe I'll 
take one!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Haahahaa! So you appreciate my art, do 
you?! —To someone like you, all I can say 
is, 'Thank you for your purchase!'"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“Now wrap it up,
Assistant Manager! Let us 
spread the flame of my crest,
the ‘Mark of 
Hamlet’!”
choice_data_list: Oh, this looks good too...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, a sudden epiphany struck me. 
Something that leaves a physical form 
cannot capture a fleeting moment...!"
choice_data_list: Oh, this looks good too...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
An ornament blessed with eternal favor?
If 
ever asked to create such a thing—
I surely 
wouldn't be able to deliver.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, for the second glass, a Bull 
Shot. Arranged as a mocktail. Its meaning 
is—"Unchanging Days."
choice_data_list: Whoa... it tastes like soup!
It... it tastes like soup!

text_block_list.text:
It's closer to a meal than a mocktail. To 
think there could be such a difference in 
taste and experience...
choice_data_list: Whoa... It tastes like soup!
Whoa... it tastes just like soup!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Have you peered into the Well 
of Barhut?! Yet, you have merely stepped 
onto the edge of the abyss!
choice_data_list: Mocktails really do have a lot of ...
Mocktails really are fascinatingly...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"There are as many recipes as there were 
aides to Bacchus— and the twist changes 
depending on the guest's taste! Hence, 
there is always 'a drink meant just for 
you'!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For instance—Trainer. I shall present to 
you the fleeting instant you truly 
desire!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A non-alcoholic gin base, shaken with 
apricot syrup and orange juice.
That right 
there is a paradise painted by 
Tintoretto...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The sun was unruly tonight, so I added 
extra gin. I tailored it for a drier 
taste. How is it?
choice_data_list: ...It's not too sweet, and it's so...

text_block_list.text:
"Just the right balance of sweet and 
sour—leaving behind a refreshing 
aftertaste. A cup that truly feels like 
the start of summer! As I admired it..."
choice_data_list: ...It's not too sweet, and it's su...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —You have a great look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Not to the god of wine. Intoxicated by my 
single glass... by me. That very 
expression on your face is—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's it. Why did I overlook the 
Lighthouse of Alexandria?! Right, I was...
choice_data_list: G-Gimlet?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—I've decided, Trainer!! I'm going to 
create a bar that intoxicates the whole 
world!
choice_data_list: G-Gimlet?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It is the Spring of Juturna that heals
the 
people, or perhaps the Rainbow Bridge 
guiding the way to Asgard!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Nectar alone does not make a tavern! Mere 
imitation of Bacchus yields no true 
intoxication! I shall shatter that 
conventional wisdom into pieces!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"That is the next fleeting moment I
seek!! 
The El Dorado I must someday reach!!!"
choice_data_list: That's a wonderful dream, I'll be ...
That's a wonderful dream, I'll be ...

text_block_list.text:
I told her that, seeing her find a new 
dream. ...Now, I had something to look 
forward to:
visiting the bar she'd run one 
day.
choice_data_list: That's a wonderful dream. I'll sup...
That's a wonderful dream. I'll sup...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Ah, I hadn't told you yet, had I? 
The name of this mocktail is 'Paradise'—
choice_data_list: By the way, what's the name of thi...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: It means "In the middle of a dream."
